about: Engine v2 O20 (#2812): every store that is not in a world's log, its path under the machine's data folder (<world> for each world's folder), its kind, how it is copied and at most how often it ships when it changed (ship_s, at most 300). A task that adds a store adds a line; v2/tools/ops/backup/tests/stores.rs fails on a file no line covers. Runbook: v2/docs/runbook/restore-stores.md.

stores.name: accounts
stores.task: W1 (#2704); R13's mailbox (#2753) is a table in it
stores.about: each sign-in's account and principal; the owner's mailbox (R13's mailbox_v1 table). The owner holds the file exclusively, so it hands the copy over (Store::backup)

stores.name: pairing
stores.about: pairing requests and each paired Soul's token hash, never a token

stores.name: gateway-tokens
stores.about: the gateway's <grant> <sha-256> lines, written whole from the pairing store and renamed into place

stores.name: text
stores.about: every word of free text and every upload (uploads/<reference>, its record in text), with the removal list

stores.name: removals
stores.about: the text store's removal list, append-only and never words: shipped within a second of a change, so a removal is not lost with the words' five minutes

stores.name: log
stores.about: the world's log: O3 ships it as pieces, not this list

stores.name: checkpoints
stores.about: the log's checkpoints: O3 ships them

stores.name: usage
stores.about: per Soul and day: acts, refusals, latest client; the owning account id (operator's store only)

stores.name: health-history
stores.about: bounded history of the health page's numbers, at most 64 MiB

stores.name: world-directory
stores.about: durable create intents, immutable names, world claims and the list refer to the same placed identity

stores.name: placement-backup
stores.about: private data-only placement receipts and authority mapping; restore revalidates the durable name, creator and trusted catalogue before probing and republishing

stores.name: world-tokens
stores.about: only this world grant hashes; directory pairing SQL remains the authority and republishes after restore

stores.name: world-soul-notices
stores.about: only this world profile/retirement notices, also reconstructible from pairing SQL
